task_name: Define startup config and shared spend guard

strengths: The startup config uses the repository's existing Zod string-enum/default pattern; it defaults to the exact string false and rejects values outside true/false (server/src/config.ts:56-66).
Configuration tests cover absent/default false, explicit false and true, and invalid input through resolveConfig (server/src/__tests__/config.test.ts:9-47).

There is one shared assertion and typed error with the required stable code/message, and both are exposed through the agent module public API using a NodeNext .js specifier (server/src/modules/agent/spend-kill-switch.ts:1-16; server/src/modules/agent/index.ts:16-19).
Guard tests exercise allowed absent/false cases and verify the enabled case throws the public typed error with exact code/message (server/src/modules/agent/spend-kill-switch.test.ts:32-60).

The env example documents the default and startup-only/recreation behavior (server/.env.example:32-36). No changed file crosses the 300-line heuristic; no function exceeds ~50 lines, and no identical logic is duplicated 3+ times in the scoped diff.
